svg.title: Ideal standard software delivery pipeline
svg.desc: An organization-wide delivery flow showing required gates, recommended golden-path steps, profile-specific extensions, production verification, rollback, governance, and audit controls.
svg.text: One required control baseline, a supported golden path, and bounded workload-specific extensions
Required outcomes and evidence cannot be bypassed
owner, data class, risk tier, profile
Required PR gates run in parallel
Recommended: cancel stale runs, preview env, evidence-linked AI summary
3 PROTECTED BUILD — CREATE ONE RELEASE CANDIDATE
4 PRE-PRODUCTION VALIDATION — PROMOTE THE SAME VERIFIED BUNDLE
Required outcome; exact environment sequence varies by workload profile
ANY FAILED GATE OR PRODUCTION REGRESSION
Preserve evidence -> notify owner -> AI may summarize or propose -> human-approved remediation PR -> restart at the correct gate
Before production: stop promotion. In production: halt rollout and use the approved recovery plan; roll back only when compatibility allows.
May add assurance at documented hooks.
May not bypass a required gate, replace the
canary analysis, regional or device waves
Build once. Promote by immutable identity. Preserve evidence. Keep AI advisory. Allow extensions, never bypasses.
